description: Adds, updates and removes project hook.

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: hook_url
parameters.description: The URL that you want GitLab to post to, this is used as the primary key for updates and deletion.

parameters.name: hook_validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether GitLab performs SSL verification when triggering the hook. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: issues_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on issues events. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: job_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on job events. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: merge_requests_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on merge requests events. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: note_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on note events or when someone adds a comment. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: pipeline_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on pipeline events. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: ID or Full path of the project in the form of group/name.

parameters.name: push_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on push events. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: push_events_branch_filter
parameters.description: Branch name of wildcard to trigger hook on push events. Default: ""

parameters.name: releases_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on release events. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: When present the hook is updated to match the input or created if it does not exist. When absent hook is deleted if it exists. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: tag_push_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on tag push events. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Secret token to validate hook messages at the receiver. If this is present it always results in a change as it cannot be retrieved from GitLab. It shows up in the X-GitLab-Token HTTP request header.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wiki_page_events
parameters.description: Trigger hook on wiki events. Choices: false ← (default) true

examples:
- name: "Adding a project hook"
  community.general.gitlab_hook:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    hook_url: "https://my-ci-server.example.com/gitlab-hook"
    state: present
    push_events: true
    tag_push_events: true
    token: "my-super-secret-token-that-my-ci-server-will-check"

- name: "Delete the previous hook"
  community.general.gitlab_hook:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    project: "my_group/my_project"
    hook_url: "https://my-ci-server.example.com/gitlab-hook"
    state: absent

- name: "Delete a hook by numeric project id"
  community.general.gitlab_hook:
    api_url: https://gitlab.example.com/
    api_token: "{{ access_token }}"
    project: 10
    hook_url: "https://my-ci-server.example.com/gitlab-hook"
    state: absent

return_values.name: error
return_values.description: The error message returned by the GitLab API. Returned: failed Sample: "400: path is already in use"

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Success"

return_values.name: result
return_values.description: JSON parsed response from the server. Returned: always
